name: Iron Tempest
look: a robot Zapdos with huge jagged glowing yellow lightning wings, a gold diamond face with pixel eyes in a steel throwing star under a V of gold spikes, a long brown spear beak and banded orange legs with black claws
entry: A Pokémon resembling Zapdos, described in an expedition log about a storm that came down to fight. It folds its blazing wings round its prey like a cage, and its spear of a beak can pierce a steel plate.
how: Wild: very rare on mountains and hills during thunderstorms.
